description_en: Queries the certificate list of a user
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-certs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-5yd0000tb02 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCerts

parameters.help_en: The page number of the paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询的页码。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of rows per page in a paged query. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页的行数。默认值为10，最大100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of encryption algorithm. Valid values:

NotSM2 (default): a non-Chinese cryptographic algorithm.

SM2: a Chinese cryptographic algorithm
parameters.help_zh:
加密算法类型。取值：

NotSM2（默认）：表示非国密算法。

SM2：表示国密算法
parameters.name: algorithm

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

AfterDate.description_en: The expiration time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
AfterDate.description_zh: 到期时间。Unix 时间戳格式，单位：毫秒（ms）

BeforeDate.description_en: The effective period. The value is a UNIX timestamp in the format of milliseconds (ms)
BeforeDate.description_zh: 生效时间。Unix 时间戳格式，单位：毫秒（ms）

CertIdentifier.description_en: The global certificate ID, which is in the format of certificate ID + "-cn-hangzhou". For example, if the certificate ID is 123, the CertIdentifier is "123-cn-hangzhou"

Domain.description_en: The domain name supported by the certificate

IsChainCompleted.description_en:
Indicates whether the certificate chain is complete. Valid values:

true: The certificate chain is complete.

false: The certificate chain is incomplete
IsChainCompleted.description_zh:
证书链是否完整。取值：

true：表示完整。

false：表示不完整

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
